text:
Zoe: Very brief: need to finalize the Console form patterns before the next sprint. Three hotspots: inline vs summary for lengthy forms, how we surface "required" in dense contexts, and the canonical delete confirmation UX (undo toast vs typed-confirm). Keep replies short + rationale.

Dana: Inline-first for immediate feedback. But for any form where users can edit multiple unrelated fields (bulk-edit, import wizard) show a top summary on submit with anchors. UX reason: prevents repetitive scrolling/searching.

Miguel: Implementation note: top-summary should list errors with short snippets and a focus target id. Server payload: errors: [{key: "email", message: "invalid", anchor: "#email"}] so client can build anchors.

Priya: Required markers: asterisk is compact but ambiguous. Proposal: use asterisk visually + site-wide setting (user preference) to show explicit "Required" helper for power users. Always include sr-only "Required" text and aria-required on inputs.

Sam: Accessibility nit: when using top-summary we must call focus() on the summary container and set role="alert" so screen readers announce it. Anchor links should call element.focus({preventScroll:true}) then scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) so keyboard focus doesn't get lost.

Dana: Deletion patterns: single-item -> inline confirm + adaptive undo toast (duration 8s default, but respect reduced-motion/reduced-timeout prefs). Bulk -> modal showing scope count + flat list preview (max 7 items) and option to export list before confirming. Permanent -> typed-confirm but require slug (resource-id) not display name to reduce accidental matches.

Miguel: On typed-confirm case-sensitivity: require exact slug match but allow copy/paste. Show monospace preview and helper: "This will permanently delete resource-id: my-project-42 and cannot be undone."

Priya: Edge-case: if snackbar gets lost (mobile/slow networks) users must still be able to recover via Trash/Activity — ensure we surface a contextual link to Trash from the toast and from resource list rows. Analytics: track undo clicks, restore-from-trash, and typed-confirm completions.

Sam: Microcopy suggestions:
- Undo toast: "Moved to Trash — Undo"
- Bulk toast: "Deleted 14 items from Project X. Restore from Trash within 30 days. View Trash"
- Typed-confirm title: "Permanently delete resource" helper: "Type the resource id to confirm: 
my-project-42"

Zoe: Quick decisions proposed: 1) Default inline validation (format checks on blur, presence on submit). 2) Use top-summary for forms >7 fields OR multi-step/bulk flows. 3) Required: '*' + sr-only "Required"; user setting to toggle visible helper. 4) Delete: soft-delete + undo for single; modal with scope + typed-confirm (slug) for permanent/bulk.

Dana: +1. Also add a small UX: when navigating from top-summary anchors, highlight the field briefly (2s) with an accessible transparent overlay so keyboard users see context.

Miguel: I'll add code snippets for the error payload and anchor handling in the pattern doc. Example: 
```
POST /submit -> { errors: [ { "field": "email", "message": "Invalid email", "anchorId": "#email" } ] }
```

Priya: I'll draft a11y checklist and SR snippets. Include examples for aria-live politeness levels for autosave forms.

Sam: I'll create 3 microcopy variants for toasts and typed-confirm. Targeting clarity + friendliness.

design-bot: Created task "forms/patterns/validation-required-delete-slug-confirm" -> /design-system/issues/742.

Zoe: Action items: Miguel to draft payload + code examples, Priya to write accessibility checklist and SR CSS snippets, Sam to author microcopy, Dana to prototype the user-pref toggle for visible "Required" helpers. Aim: pattern doc in design-system by Wednesday for review.

Dana: Will prototype toggle and show before EOD Tuesday.

Miguel: Will post PR link when ready.

Priya: tagging @sam for copy review. :eyes":
